HOME.title: Karen Rincón
HOME.about:
I specialize in Web Development and Software Development. I work with architectures such as DDD, Hexagonal, and MVC, and have knowledge of design patterns such as Singleton, Observer, Factory, among others.

I have experience with development engines like Unity, creating interactions in Virtual Reality (VR) and Augmented Reality (AR). Additionally, I have a great passion for CG Art (Computer Graphics).

card_1.title: UNO Scoreboard
card_1.shortDescription: REST API for the UNO game scoring system.
card_1.description: This project was developed in Java. Based on Bounded Context design, DDD architecture, and Event Sourcing programming, it implements a scoring system for the UNO game, considering rules, card types, and turns.

card_2.title: Chefly
card_2.shortDescription: REST API for restaurant operations management.
card_2.description: This REST API was developed in Java using SpringBoot and connected to a MySQL database. It is based on the MVC architecture and design patterns such as Observer, Chain of Responsibility, State, and Singleton.

card_3.title: AirSofka Login
card_3.shortDescription: REST API for flight page login system.
card_3.description: This collaborative project was developed in Java. Based on Bounded Context design, DDD architecture, and event-driven programming (Event Sourcing), it implements a login system for a flight booking page that allows user authentication locally or via Google. The backend is designed for a single superuser (admin). Upon user login, a token is generated and stored as a cookie on the frontend. Adapters and ports were used to store information in both a MySQL database and MongoDB Atlas.

card_1.title: WiridLAB
card_1.shortDescription: 360° virtual tour of a lab with object interaction.
card_1.description: Six-month project involving the creation of a virtual tour of a telecommunications lab with 3D object interaction. I was responsible for coding the application and leading the development team. The project was negotiated directly with the client and managed using the Scrum methodology, ensuring an agile and organized delivery throughout the process.

card_2.title: PianoPin
card_2.shortDescription: Authentication proposal for users on VR platforms.
card_2.description: One-month project developed as a proposed solution for user authentication on immersive platforms like Virtual Reality. PianoPin aims to authenticate users through melody creation. I was in charge of the coding, considering note duration, start time, and an acceptable timing offset range. This application requires Leap Motion.
